page.layout: Running head across the top: "INVOCAT. SANCT." with page number 247 at right. Below: two parallel columns of italic verse (left and right), separated by a central rule; a centred heading "ALIA:" above the verse; below the verse a centred heading "ORATIO." then a prose paragraph in roman type with an initial "DEus"; signature "Q 4" and "DE" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: ALIA:
ORATIO.
main_text.p: DEus, qui beatum Nicolaum confessorem tuum, sanctimonia sacræ religionis insignem, miraculis magnis clarificare non desinis; concede propitius, ut, qui ejus patrocinia devote poscimus, dono tuæ gratiæ consequamur.

page.notes: Catchword and signature "DE" at foot read as printed; the "DE" is likely the start of the next gathering signature, uncertain. Several verse words in the left column are damaged and marked as read.
